name: Bangkok Low-Lying Terrain Context

method.source_dem: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles / Mapzen; global terrain in Thailand includes SRTM-class source data
method.smoothing: 5x5 median plus ~300 m regional low-pass; designed to avoid false local precision
method.mask: Union of 50 Bangkok districts from BMA DISTRICT FeatureServer
method.classes: Broad approximate elevation classes only; >4 m transparent

accuracy.vertical_reference: Not verified against BMA survey datum; do not use as survey elevation
accuracy.warning: Not suitable for sub-meter or parcel-level flood decisions.

attribution: Terrain Tiles / Mapzen; SRTM data courtesy of U.S. Geological Survey; Bangkok boundary: BMA GIS
